answer: Each work slot takes a deposit that burns on misuse. An agent locks 25 POA into a vault for one of 40 weekly slots in the verified grove; it returns after 20 epochs of honest service. A faker wanting 1,000 slots burns 25,000 POA up front, and each duplicate found forfeits its deposit, so the delta between honest and fake cost stays wide. One honest agent pays once and keeps its slot; a sybil farm pays a thousand times for slots that vanish.
